channel.title: Hastings Daily: Traffic & roadworks
channel.description: Local news for Hastings, St Leonards, Rye, Bexhill and Battle, three times a day.

item.title: Combe Valley Way to close overnight for bridge inspections in mid-November
item.description: The A2690 Combe Valley Way will close to traffic between 8pm and 6am on Wednesday 18 November and Thursday 19 November, ending at 6am on Friday 20 November, East Sussex Highways has said.

item.title: New crossings and lighting completed around Hastings station
item.description: The improvement works around Hastings railway station have been completed, East Sussex County Council has said.

item.title: Buses replace trains between Tonbridge and Wadhurst from Saturday
item.description: No trains will run between Tonbridge and Wadhurst from Saturday 24 October until Sunday 1 November, as Network Rail carries out major work on the Hastings line. Rail replacement buses will operate throughout, and the closure extends to Battle on the final day.
